serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Ultra is an agentic security platform that secures AI agents and their tool use at runtime. A customer-deployed enforcement point sits inline — authenticating, proxying, and governing every agent and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool call — while Ultra Hub delivers centralized identity, policy, guardrails, and observability across the agent runtime. Together they give organizations autonomous-runtime security: real-time visibility and control over what AI agents can access and do, so agentic AI can be deployed and scaled safely.
